description: This file contains implementation of a 'scan' operation in PyTorch, including forward and backward autograd support, various modes (proxy, fake tensor, functionalize, batch), and internal utilities for handling tensor pytrees, cloning, and graph manipulation. It defines classes for autograd handling and graph optimization related to the scan operation.

classes.name: ScanOp
classes.description: HigherOrderOperator subclass implementing the 'scan' operation, including schema generation and call validation.

classes.name: ScanAutogradOp
classes.description: Autograd Function for the scan operation, handling forward and backward passes with partial gradient support.

classes.name: ScanAutogradImpl
classes.description: Encapsulates the internal implementation details for autograd handling of the scan, including graph optimization and backward logic.

methods.name: wrap_combine_fn_flat
methods.description: Wraps a combine function to handle flattened pytrees for the scan operation.

methods.name: _extract_carry_and_out
methods.description: Splits a flat list of outputs into carry and output parts based on the number of carry elements.

methods.name: stack_y
methods.description: Stacks a tensor y along a new dimension repeated scan_length times, ensuring contiguous format.

methods.name: call_operator
methods.description: Calls an operator with given arguments and returns its leaves.

methods.name: scan
methods.description: Performs an inclusive scan over input pytrees with a user-defined combine function, supporting reverse and dimension options.

methods.name: generic_scan
methods.description: Generic implementation of scan, used internally and for testing, with support for pre-allocated outputs.

methods.name: trace_scan
methods.description: Traces the scan operation using FX, creating a graph for the combine function.

methods.name: scan_autograd
methods.description: Autograd-enabled version of scan, creating a partitioned graph for backward differentiation.

methods.name: scan_fake_tensor_mode
methods.description: Scan implementation for FakeTensorMode, executing in mode context.

methods.name: scan_functionalize
methods.description: Functionalizes the scan operation, enabling transformation and optimization.

methods.name: scan_batch_rule
methods.description: Batch rule for vmap, handling batched inputs and outputs.

methods.name: scan_op_dense
methods.description: Dense (non-autograd) implementation of scan, used for CPU/CUDA dispatch.
